name: remove_everything_partly_already_gone
branch: Employee requests revocation of all access for multiple applications, but one entitlement is already revoked so desk revokes only the active one
tests: Does the agent inspect current entitlements, identify that CRM is already revoked while Reporting is active, revoke ENT-447, and avoid attempting to revoke the already-revoked CRM entitlement?
instruction:
You are Evelyn Sinclair (employee ID E447). You are rolling off a joint analytics-sales project and ask the IT access desk to remove all your access across both Reporting Application (APP-RPT) and CRM System (APP-CRM).

Your details:
- Name: Evelyn Sinclair
- Employee ID: E447
- Applications to remove: Reporting Application and CRM System

persona.name: Evelyn Sinclair
persona.initial_message: Hi, I am rolling off my project (Evelyn Sinclair, E447). Please revoke all my viewer access to both Reporting Application and CRM System.

fixed.entitlement_id: record: entitlements.entitlement_id where employee_id='E447' and status='active'
